purpose.summary: This is the main menu/control program for the ACAS (Applewood Computers Accounting System), an open-source accounting package. It presents a top-level menu allowing users to navigate to sub-systems such as IRS (ledger), Sales, Purchase, Stock, General, and optionally Payroll, EPOS, and Order Entry. It also handles first-time system setup, terminal size validation, and environment variable configuration.

notable_features: Extensive use of COPY copybooks (wsnames.cob, wssystem.cob, wsmaps01.cob, etc.)
COPY ... REPLACING with many field renaming substitutions
SET ENVIRONMENT intrinsic for screen exception handling
Terminal size validation (lines >= 24, columns >= 80) with retry loop using GO TO
14 CALL statements to sub-programs (IRS, Sales, Purchase, Stock, General, sys002, Maps01, etc.)
GNU GPL v2 license header with commercial support pricing
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 26552 bytes; the procedure division is only partially visible. The program is clearly a real production accounting system (ACAS) with a long version history. The GnuCOBOL dialect is confirmed by the >>source free directive and GnuCOBOL-specific environment intrinsics. The high comment ratio (50%) is due to extensive copyright, change-log, and documentation comments.
